purpose: Use the original NWM-S checkpoint and its completed H4 planner outputs to separate world-model ranking, project scoring, safety gating, CEM search, and cross-round archive contributions.

claim_scope.label_status: official-100 outcomes are already opened; this is a new exploratory attribution
claim_scope.same_fixed_pool_comparison: K17 = trimmed-mean incumbent plus the same NoMaD x16 candidates

nwm_s.score: decoded final-frame LPIPS-Alex to goal image

fixed_k17_scorer_axis.name: dino_static_only
fixed_k17_scorer_axis.definition: candidate-invariant DINO scene/goal context; score ties retain incumbent

fixed_k17_scorer_axis.name: nwm_s_lpips_raw
fixed_k17_scorer_axis.definition: NWM-S CDiT-S/2 250-step rollout plus final-frame LPIPS argmin over NoMaD x16

fixed_k17_scorer_axis.name: nwm_s_valid_fallback
fixed_k17_scorer_axis.definition: accept the NWM-S challenger only when the frozen v70 physical/support validity mask accepts it

fixed_k17_scorer_axis.name: nwm_s_v70_safe_fallback
fixed_k17_scorer_axis.definition: accept the NWM-S challenger only when the frozen v70 dual/harm/UCB gate marks that exact candidate safe; otherwise retain incumbent

fixed_k17_scorer_axis.name: project_scorer_v2_raw_argmin
fixed_k17_scorer_axis.definition: project DWM/scorer-v2 raw K17 energy without the v70 safe selector

fixed_k17_scorer_axis.name: v70_fixed_k17
fixed_k17_scorer_axis.definition: project v70 energy plus validity, uncertainty-aware safe gate, and incumbent fallback on the same K17 pool

search_selector_axis.name: v70_final_round_only
search_selector_axis.definition: three CEM updates but select only from the last-round population

search_selector_axis.name: v70_cross_round_archive
search_selector_axis.definition: three CEM rounds plus safe archive across K17 and every round

search_selector_axis.name: union65_objective_oracle
search_selector_axis.definition: outcome-only ceiling; never a deployable method

interpretation_rules.nwm_weight_signal: NWM-S raw must beat the common incumbent on paired ATE; otherwise the original world-model ranker is not the source of the gain on this pool.
interpretation_rules.project_ranker_signal: v70 fixed-K17 must beat NWM-S plus the same v70 safe fallback, isolating ranking under a common pool and safety mechanism.
interpretation_rules.selector_signal: NWM-S plus v70 safe fallback must reduce harm versus raw NWM-S, and v70 archive must beat fixed-K17/final-round-only.
interpretation_rules.dependency_boundary: NWM-S and project v70 use different learned world models; this experiment compares action-selection behavior, not parameter-level interchangeability.
